title: How old Austins were built
author: codex-blog-rewrite
excerpt: Old Austins are understood by their production period: early Longbridge work, the Seven, volume production, BMC and shared components.
content:
Old Austins were not all built in the same way. Between the first Longbridge cars, the Austin Seven, post-war models and BMC cars, methods changed considerably. Production followed market size, factory capacity and group method.

Understanding that construction helps when evaluation a car today. Assembly, shared parts, bodywork, trim and corrosion points depend greatly on period.

Repair with method

The Austin page provides the timeline. The Austin and Morris Mini then shows a mature case of compact volume construction.
